description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of emotional states across a dataset, likely from the paper “Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech,” with five distinct categories shown as slices: Frustration (25.1%, light blue), Neutral (23.1%, medium blue), Anger (14.9%, yellow), Sadness (14.7%, orange), and Happiness (14.1%, red). The chart includes percentage labels directly within each corresponding slice and is accompanied by a legend, though the legend itself is not fully visible in the image. The segments are arranged in a clockwise descending order by size, starting from the top with Frustration. A gray rectangular placeholder, possibly indicating a missing or unassigned category, is positioned below the chart.
